title: OpenRouteService Isochrones Request
description: Request body schema for the OpenRouteService Isochrones API endpoint

locations.description: Center coordinates for isochrone computation as [longitude, latitude] pairs. Maximum 5.

range.description: Maximum travel range values. For time-based: seconds. For distance-based: meters. Maximum 10 values.

interval.description: Interval for creating concentric isochrone rings within the maximum range

area_units.description: Units for area computation in the response

attributes.description: Additional attributes to compute and include in the response

intersections.description: Compute and return intersections between isochrone polygons

smoothing.description: Smoothing factor for isochrone polygon edges (0 = no smoothing, 1 = maximum smoothing)

avoid_features.description: Road features to avoid when computing reachability

avoid_polygons.description: GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon defining areas to avoid

id.description: Arbitrary identifier echoed back in the response
